Under cost_of_capital.missing it prints: "the cost of equity needs a beta and a price: no price series was given: the forward track's price source is Tiingo, and without its token no series is fetched". Three WACC inputs are on record: the risk-free rate of {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate|pct}, the equity risk premium of {cost_of_capital.equity_risk_premium|pct} and the pre-tax cost of debt of {cost_of_capital.pre_tax_cost_of_debt|pct}. Beta, the market value of equity and the cost of equity are not. The tax rate is also printed as missing, because the record has no pre-tax income row for the latest quarter. What can be read is how the drivers sit against the company's own record. The base case starts growth slightly above trailing four-quarter growth of {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}. That is far above the three-year compound of {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound|pct} and the five-year compound of {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_five_year_compound|pct}. So the base case is a judgment that the recent recovery lasts, not an extension of the longer record. The bear case keeps growth above the three-year compound and lets margin slip just below that average by year ten. The bull case starts near the guided pace and puts margins above any filed year. All three model the consolidated company as filed, before the planned CPI spin-off.

The bear case starts below trailing four-quarter growth of {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}, the base case slightly above it, and the bull case near the latest quarter's {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct}. most_sensitive.assumption: operating margin by year ten (where the drivers stand furthest from the record; not a measured sensitivity)
most_sensitive.reading: This is also not read off a grid, because none was computed. The base and bull margins at year ten sit above every filed year. Operating margin ran from {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.operating_margin|pct} in fiscal 2024 to {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_margin|pct} in fiscal 2026, with a three-year average of {earnings_versus_cash.history.operating_margin_three_year_average|pct}. The bear case falls back just below that average. On a margin this thin, a small move in the percentage is a large move in operating income. Trailing operating income grew {ratios.growth.operating_income.trailing_four_quarters|pct} against revenue growth of {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}. The calculator could not compute return on invested capital either. accounting_adjustments.reading: No accounting adjustment was written. Because the valuation was not computed, there is also no value effect to read. The accounting reader states "I add no adjustment." Its reasons: the divestiture gain, the working-capital release funded by payables and any lift from receivables factoring each lack a calculator field carrying the amount, and the changes in receivables and payables already sit inside operating cash flow. The calculator's quality-adjusted free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted} subtracts share-based compensation and the EPP purchase from simple free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}, and applies nothing further. The accounting reader's findings shaped the drivers instead of a line adjustment. Payables rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change} over the year, and trade working capital fell from {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.trade_working_capital.a_year_earlier} to {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.trade_working_capital.now}. That is why every scenario reinvests heavily in year one rather than assuming the supplier credit repeats. Free cash flow to equity of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_equity} is overstated because borrowing is counted gross. The DCF works on cash flow to the firm, though, so that error would not enter it.

limits: This valuation is a set of stated assumptions run through a stated formula. It states no recommendation to trade, and a different reader choosing different drivers would reach a different value.
